plainTranslation: Their Saturn in your 12th house can press on hidden fears, loneliness, guilt, or old survival patterns. They may become a serious mirror for what you avoid. Move carefully; responsibility is useful only when it does not become invisible burden.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Refined from approved project relationship source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
